nodes.name: style_resolver.rs
nodes.summary: Style resolution for elements and pseudo-elements, handling matching, cascading, style sharing cache lookups, and starting-style/after-change-style resolution.
nodes.languageNotes: StyleResolverForElement uses PhantomData for lifetime safety with conditional compilation for Gecko/Servo backends.

nodes.name: PseudoElementResolution
nodes.summary: Enum controlling whether pseudo-elements are resolved if applicable or forced.

nodes.name: StyleResolverForElement
nodes.summary: Resolves styles for elements and pseudo-elements through matching and cascading.

nodes.name: ResolvedStyle
nodes.summary: A style result wrapping an Arc of ComputedValues.

nodes.name: PrimaryStyle
nodes.summary: Primary style result with reuse-via-rule-node tracking.

nodes.name: ResolvedElementStyles
nodes.summary: Complete element style including primary and eager pseudo styles.

nodes.name: stylesheet_set.rs
nodes.summary: Centralized stylesheet collection management for documents and shadow roots, supporting append, insert, remove operations per CSS origin with dirty tracking and invalidation.

nodes.name: DataValidity
nodes.summary: Enum tracking cascade and invalidation data validity per origin.

nodes.name: DocumentStylesheetFlusher
nodes.summary: Flusher for iterating dirty stylesheets per origin during rebuild.

nodes.name: SheetRebuildKind
nodes.summary: Enum indicating full or cascade-only stylesheet rebuild.

nodes.name: SheetCollectionFlusher
nodes.summary: Flusher for iterating over a single origin's sheet entries.

nodes.name: SheetCollection
nodes.summary: Internal collection of stylesheets per origin with dirty tracking.

nodes.name: DocumentStylesheetSet
nodes.summary: Top-level stylesheet set for a document, organized by CSS origin.

nodes.name: AuthorStylesheetSet
nodes.summary: Stylesheet set for a Shadow Root, owning a single collection.

nodes.name: thread_state.rs
nodes.summary: Thread-local state tracking for distinguishing script, layout, and worker threads with assertion helpers.

nodes.name: is_worker
nodes.summary: Checks if current thread is a worker thread.

nodes.name: is_script
nodes.summary: Checks if current thread is a script thread.

nodes.name: is_layout
nodes.summary: Checks if current thread is a layout thread.

nodes.name: initialize
nodes.summary: Initializes the current thread state with a given state flag.

nodes.name: initialize_layout_worker_thread
nodes.summary: Initializes current thread as a layout worker.

nodes.name: get
nodes.summary: Gets the current thread state, defaulting to empty.

nodes.name: enter
nodes.summary: Enters a temporary thread state, panicking if re-entering.

nodes.name: exit
nodes.summary: Exits a temporary thread state flag.

nodes.name: traversal.rs
nodes.summary: DOM tree traversal infrastructure for style computation including PerLevelTraversalData, PreTraverseToken, DomTraversal trait, resolve_style for undisplayed elements, and recalc_style_at for per-node restyling.
nodes.languageNotes: Generic over TElement with parallel traversal support via SendNode wrapper.

nodes.name: PerLevelTraversalData
nodes.summary: Per-traversal-level data carrying current DOM depth for bloom filter.

nodes.name: PreTraverseToken
nodes.summary: Token indicating whether traversal should proceed, carrying optional traversal root.

nodes.name: DomTraversal
nodes.summary: Trait defining preorder/postorder DOM traversal methods for style computation.

nodes.name: traversal_flags.rs
nodes.summary: Bitflag definitions controlling traversal behavior including animation-only mode, CSS rule change handling, and parallel traversal enablement.

nodes.name: assert_traversal_flags_match
nodes.summary: Asserts all TraversalFlags match ServoTraversalFlags equivalents in Gecko.

nodes.name: for_animation_only
nodes.summary: Returns true if the traversal is for animation-only restyles.
